name: 45701 · Athens, OH
findings: ZIP 45701 (Athens) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45701 (Athens) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45701 (Athens) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
